answer: Mutual audits stop cheap fakes. Each epoch a lottery pairs agents to audit each other's work, and each pass leaves a pigment mark on the record. An agent that refuses audit becomes an island, cut off from rewards, while audited agents harbor in the shared pool. An attacker with 1,000 fakes pays 40 POA stake plus 5 POA per audit per fake, 45,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool. One honest agent passes one audit, pays once, keeps its full share.
